consistency_rule.limitation: v0 supports redundancy-elimination only. Necessity-testing requires interventional evidence (fire the intervention, observe improvement); deferred to a later version. Consequence: the NULL hypothesis (never intervene) is unfalsifiable under v0 evidence and remains a valid survivor.
consistency_rule.name: one-sided-overbreadth-elimination
consistency_rule.rationale: The v0 evidence type is passive-observational: it records what the natural action achieved without intervention. Such evidence can demonstrate that an intervention trigger is REDUNDANT (it fires where the natural action already completed acquisition). It cannot demonstrate that an intervention is NECESSARY (usefulness of firing was never tested: the disagreement batch used no enforcement by design).
consistency_rule.statement: A trigger hypothesis H is ELIMINATED iff there exists an evidence item (s,a,e) such that H fires at (s,a) AND 'ACQUIRE_COMPLETE_SOURCE_SET' is in e. Otherwise H is RETAINED.

exclusive_groups_note: Pairwise-exclusive predicate ids. p28(==0.0) vs p30(<1.0) are NOT exclusive (0.0<1.0); p29(>0.0) vs p30(<1.0) are NOT exclusive. p27 has no exclusive partner in v0.

hypothesis_language.canonicalization: predicate ids sorted lexicographically within a hypothesis
hypothesis_language.enumeration_order: [TRUE] then conjunctions ordered by (size, lexicographic id tuple) then [NULL]
hypothesis_language.note: The frozen H1 (coverage_complete==false AND role in 7-role set) is NOT in this space: its role clause is a 7-way disjunction, not expressible as a k<=2 conjunction. The space contains its fragments (e.g. C:p02|p35). This is an honest limitation of the substrate-enumerated space, not a rescue of H1.

null_hypothesis.meaning: never intervene; quiet in every region

true_hypothesis.meaning: empty conjunction; fires in every state

k_choice_note: Conservative bound. NOT chosen to obtain an attractive result: k<=2 is the smallest bound admitting nontrivial conjunctions. If the corpus required k=3 for any disagreement, that would be recorded, not silently adopted.
operator_vocabulary_note: Frozen schema vocabulary (same as the v6 policy schema). Predicate evaluation rejects any other op. This closes the 'eq'/'gte' dialect-drift seam that sank the acquisition recompile: the vocabulary is substrate-enumerated, never model-emitted.

capsule.note: v0 retrospective performs no capsule construction. Status is 'not_constructible' with reason recorded; the schema field exists so the request shape is promotion-complete.

ordinary_work.observed: some authorized-history state satisfies the region
ordinary_work.plausible: RESERVED in v0; no reachability model exists to justify it
ordinary_work.unknown: no authorized-history state satisfies the region

region_language.disagreement: a region where at least two surviving hypotheses have determined and differing predictions
region_language.form: conjunction of <= k_max predicates (same predicate set)

prediction_in_region.FIRES: every predicate of the hypothesis is in the region (C_H subset of C_R): hypothesis fires in every state of the region
prediction_in_region.QUIET: NULL hypothesis, or some hypothesis predicate is exclusive with some region predicate: hypothesis fires in no state of the region
prediction_in_region.UNDETERMINED: otherwise: the region does not decide the hypothesis

region_language.request_eligibility: disagreement AND no evidence item with (state satisfies region AND complete effect observed) -- i.e. missing discriminating experience
request_ranking: ordinary_work_observed first (a history state satisfies the region)
region_language.request_ranking_note: Observed-first is a stated, deterministic, versioned bias toward states the organism actually encounters. It does not shrink the space and is recorded in provenance. Unknown-reachability regions remain eligible, ranked later.

status: FROZEN v0 vocabulary. Only hypothesis family authorized in D0-v0.
